{"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence showing:
- a custody failure,
- a nuclear safety lapse,
- a command-and-control breakdown,
- or Biden deliberately weakening accident-prevention safeguards.

So the negative side of this lens is mostly an absence of contrary 2024 evidence, not a balanced set of confirmed failures.","evidence":[{"title":"NNSA completes subcritical experiment at PULSE facility in Nevada","publisher":"U.S. Department of Energy, National Nuclear Security Administration","date":"May 16, 2024","url":"https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/articles/nnsa-completes-subcritical-experiment-pulse-facility-nevada","summary":"NNSA said the subcritical experiment provided essential data for the safety, security, reliability, and effectiveness of nuclear warheads without nuclear explosive testing. That is direct evidence of safety-oriented stockpile stewardship and accident-prevention discipline.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"NNSA calls attention to the security of nuclear materials in transit at International Conference on Nuclear Security","publisher":"U.S. Department of Energy, National Nuclear Security Administration","date":"May 31, 2024","url":"https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/articles/nnsa-calls-attention-security-nuclear-materials-transit-international-conference","summary":"The U.S. and UK co-sponsored an IAEA event to encourage stronger security for nuclear materials in transit, including stronger regulatory frameworks and planning for emerging threats. This supports a record of active custody and transport-safety improvement.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"Joint Press Statement on the Signing of the Nuclear Consultative Group Guidelines","publisher":"U.S. Department of Defense","date":"July 11, 2024","url":"https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/3835633/joint-press-statement-on-the-signing-of-the-nuclear-consultative-group-guidelin/","summary":"The U.S. and Republic of Korea signed formal Nuclear Consultative Group guidelines to support principles and procedures for nuclear deterrence and nuclear operations on the Korean Peninsula. This is strong evidence of disciplined, structured command-and-control coordination with an ally.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.1"]},{"title":"Joint Statement on the U.S.-ROK Nuclear Consultative Group Simulation","publisher":"U.S. Department of Defense","date":"September 6, 2024","url":"https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/3898151/joint-statement-on-the-us-rok-nuclear-consultative-group-simulation/","summary":"The first U.S.-ROK NCG simulation was designed to strengthen cooperative decision-making about nuclear deterrence and planning for nuclear contingencies. Austin III's Call With People's Republic of China (PRC) Minister of National Defense Admiral Dong Jun","publisher":"U.S. Department of Defense","date":"April 16, 2024","url":"https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/3742639/readout-of-secretary-of-defense-lloyd-j-austin-iiis-call-with-peoples-republic/","summary":"Austin emphasized continued military-to-military communication and reaffirmed resumed telephone conversations between theater commanders.
